title: IBM Cyber Fraud 1.0.0 through 1.1.0 could allow an unauthorized user to inject data into log messages due to improper…
description: IBM Cyber Fraud versions 1.0.0 through 1.1.0 contain a vulnerability that allows an unauthorized user to inject data into log messages. This occurs due to improper neutralization of special elements when writing to log files, potentially leading to log injection attacks.
